title: Shyft Group: Parking Brake May Not Engage (150 affected)
summary: Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Blue ARC BA4L-800 vehicles. The spacer for the brake caliper may be too big, resulting in an increased air gap.

title: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc.: Loss of Brake Function (2 affected)
summary: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc. (Polestar) is recalling certain 2021 and 2024 Polestar 2 vehicles. In certain driving scenarios while coasting down a hill and using "One Pedal Drive," the vehicle may lose brake function.

title: Bombardier Recreational Products, Inc.: Loss of Drive Power (843 affected)
summary: Bombardier Recreational Products, Inc. (BRP) is recalling certain 2025 Can-Am Canyon motorcycles. On these motorcycles, the drive belt lower idler support will fail and possibly cause a belt failure.

title: Autocar, LLC: Incorrect Tire Inflation Label/FMVSS 110 (195 affected)
summary: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2012-2025 ACTT (Xspotter) vehicles. The tire inflation information label is incorrect.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: Autocar, LLC: Insufficient Volume in Air Tank/FMVSS 121 (49 affected)
summary: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2015-2022 ACTT (Xspotter) and ACX (Xpeditor) vehicles. The air tanks have an insufficient volume of air for the brake system.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 121, "Air Brake Systems."

title: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc.: Electrical Malfunction from Corrosion in Wire Harness (969 affected)
summary: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc. (Polestar) is recalling certain 2025 Polestar 3 vehicles. Water may damage the electrical connectors between the engine bay and front bumper cable harnesses.

title: Ford Motor Company: Engine Oil Leak May Cause Fire (2,985 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 1.5L EcoBoost RFF Cylinder Heads, with part number PV4Z-6049-A and 1.5L RFF Long Block Engines, with part number PV4Z-6006-A, sold as replacement parts. The cylinder head may have been improperly manufactured, which can cause the ball plugs to fail, resulting in an oil leak.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Passenger Air Bag May Tear (21,000 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Jaguar) is recalling certain 2020–2025 Range Rover Evoque vehicles. The passenger air bag may tear during deployment.

title: Reading Truck Group LLC: Front Rail Gear Welds May Fail (7 affected)
summary: Reading Truck Body, LLC (Reading) is recalling certain 2021 Rail Gear HD trucks. Welds may crack and fail, allowing the front rail gear to shift and contact the road.

title: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A.: Crankshaft Bushing Can Seize and Cause Engine Stall (17,792 affected)
summary: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A. (Kawasaki) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Ninja ZX-6R motorcycles. The motorcycles may lose engine power during operation due to seizure of a metal crankshaft bushing.

title: Shyft Group: Turn Signals and Brake Lights May Fail (2,785 affected)
summary: Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain 2015-2025 Utilimaster Truck Body vehicles. The signal converter may fail, which can cause the brake lights and turn signals to become inoperative.

title: Ford Motor Company: Low Pressure Fuel Pump May Fail (850,318 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Bronco, Explorer, Lincoln Aviator, F-250 SD, F-350 SD, F-450 SD,  F-550 SD, 2021-2022 Lincoln Navigator, Mustang, F-150, and 2022 Expedition vehicles. The low-pressure fuel pump may fail, which can result in an engine stall while driving.

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: Incorrect Location for Emergency Exit Label/FMVSS 217 (321 affected)
summary: Motor Coach Industries (MCI) is recalling certain 2025 D4520, D45CRTLE, D45CRT, J3500, and 2025-2026 J4500 buses. The emergency exit label may be placed in the incorrect location. As such, these vehicles fail to conform to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."

title: Bontrager Outdoors: Missing Carbon Monoxide Detectors (24 affected)
summary: Bontrager Outdoors (Bontrager) is recalling certain 2025 Skinny Guy Campers Armor 7LT and Bontrager Outdoors 7ROD trailers. The carbon monoxide detectors may not have been installed.

title: Motiv Power Systems: High Voltage Battery May Short Circuit (55 affected)
summary: Motiv Power Systems, Inc. (Motiv) is recalling certain 2021-2024 F-59 vehicles equipped with a Motiv Gen 6 EPIC powertrain. The high voltage battery pack may be improperly sealed and allow liquid to enter the battery.

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Incorrect Entrance Door Windows Glaze Material/FMVSS 205 (35 affected)
summary: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2018-2019 X3-45 Commuter vehicles not equipped with optional perimeter lighting. The entrance door window glazing material is incorrect. As such, these vehicles fail to conform to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 205, "Glazing Materials."

title: Airstream, Inc.: Awning Can Be Extended While The Vehicle Is Moving (244 affected)
summary: Airstream, Inc. (Airstream) is recalling certain 2025 - 2026 Interstate motorhomes. The Parametric Special Module (PSM) may fail to lock the controls, allowing the awning to be extended during transit.

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Loose Passenger Seat Back and Seat Belt Fasteners (264 affected)
summary: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2025 X3-45 and 2025-2026 H3-45 coach buses. The fasteners securing the passenger seat back or the seat belt may be loose.

title: Mitsubishi Fuso Truck of America, Inc.: Excessive Brake Friction May Cause Fire (244 affected)
summary: Mitsubishi Fuso Truck of America, Inc. (MFTA) is recalling certain 2024 Rizon FEC7K (E16), FEC9K (E18), and 2025 FECXK (E18) trucks. The electric parking brake (EPB) actuator may use a spacer that is too big, resulting in excessive friction and overheated brake components.

title: Ford Motor Company: Cracked Fuel Injector May Leak and Cause a Fire (694,271 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Bronco Sport and 2020-2022 Escape vehicles equipped with 1.5L engines. A fuel injector may crack and leak fuel inside the engine compartment.

title: Malibu Boats, LLC: Loss of Brake Function from Brake Line Fracture (2,001 affected)
summary: Malibu Boats, LLC (Malibu Boats) is recalling certain 2021-2026 Triple Axle Boat Trailers. The brake line may fracture at the connection point to the caliper, causing a loss of brake function.

title: Zero Motorcycles Inc.: Damaged Brake Hose May Leak (44 affected)
summary: Zero Motorcycles Inc. (Zero) is recalling certain 2024 DSR/X, DS, DSR, and DSRP motorcycles. The front brake hose may be twisted and become damaged, which can cause a brake fluid leak and a loss of brake pressure.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Passenger Air Bag May Tear (1,436 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Jaguar) is recalling certain 2021-2024 E-Pace vehicles. The passenger air bag may tear during deployment.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Liquid Propane Hose Incorrectly Routed (41 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026 Westbrook and Tracer recreational trailers. The liquid propane (LP) gas hose may be incorrectly routed and rub against the furnace, causing a fuel leak.

title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (43,422 affected)
summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2020-2023 Mercedes-Benz Metris vehicles. The electrical connections for the infotainment system may not be properly secured, which can cause the rearview camera image not to display. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: American Manufacturing Operations, INC.: Improperly Secured Trailer Axle (2,294 affected)
summary: American Manufacturing Operations, Inc. (AMO) 2025 AMO Utility trailers. The shackle nuts securing the axle to the chassis may loosen, allowing the axle to detach from the trailer.

title: Peragon Enterprises, Inc.: Tonneau Cover May Detach During Transit (1,112 affected)
summary: Peragon Enterprises, Inc. (Peragon) is recalling certain Peragon Tectonic hard, three-panel tonneau covers. The bed cover's plastic slides may become damaged and allow the cover to detach during transit.

title: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc.: Panoramic Glass Sunroof May Detach (33 affected)
summary: Polestar Automotive USA, Inc. (Polestar) is recalling certain 2025 Polestar 3 vehicles. The panoramic glass sunroof may not be properly secured and can detach.

title: Continental Tire the Americas, LLC: Tire Sidewall May Break (542 affected)
summary: Continental Tire the Americas, LLC (CTA) is recalling certain General Tire Altimax RT45 tires, size 235/60R18. The tires may have been overcured during manufacturing.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: Loose Retaining Ring May Cause Dislodged Air Strut (284 affected)
summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2025  Panamera E-hybrid, Taycan, and Panamera vehicles. A retaining ring on top of the suspension strut may come loose, resulting in a dislodged strut and air loss from the strut spring.

title: Winnebago Towable: Cooktop Flame May Invert (527 affected)
summary: Winnebago Towable (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2025 Micro Minnie and Micro Minnie FLX travel trailers. The cooktop flame may invert when the stove and furnace are operated at the same time.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: High Voltage Battery Failure (136 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2022-2025 IX, 2023-2024 I7, and 2022-2023 i4 vehicles. The high-voltage battery cell modules may not have been assembled properly, resulting in stress on the module frame and possible module failure.

title: Volvo Bus Corporation: Automatic Fire Suppression System May Short Circuit (165 affected)
summary: Volvo Bus Corporation (Volvo Bus) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Volvo 9700 buses. Metallic debris within the electrical connectors of the Automatic Fire Suppression System (AFSS) may cause a short circuit, resulting in a false warning to the driver, an engine shutdown, and the release of chemical fire extinguishing agent in the engine compartment.

title: Grand Design RV, LLC: Door Entry Latch May Fail (625 affected)
summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Lineage recreational trailers, equipped with Lippert Modularia entrance doors. The door latch mechanism may fail.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Instrument Panel Display Failure/FMVSS 101 (4,754 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain Genesis 2023-2025 G90 and GV60 vehicles. Due to a software error, the instrument panel display may fail. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 101, "Controls and Displays."

title: Centropneus SRL: Missing DOT Markings On Tire Sidewall/FMVSS 139 (640 affected)
summary: Centropneus SRL (Centropneus) is recalling certain Michelin CrossClimate 2 tires, size 255/60R18 112V XL. The DOT certification symbol is missing from the tire sidewalls. As such, these tires fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 139, "New Pneumatic Radial Tires for Light Vehicles."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Head Restraints May Not Lock (764 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain Mopar second-row head restraints. Please refer to FCA US, LLC's recall report for specific model numbers. The head restraints may not lock in the upright position.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Head Restraints May Not Lock/FMVSS 202 (121,398 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Jeep Grand Cherokee and Jeep Grand Cherokee L vehicles. The second-row seat head restraints may not lock in the upright position. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 202, "Head Restraints."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (21 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Chrysler Pacifica vehicles. The vehicles were built with an incorrect radio, which can cause the rearview camera image not to display. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Rosenbauer America: Odometer May Freeze (788 affected)
summary: Rosenbauer America (Rosenbauer) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Avenger, 2019-2024 Commander, and Warrior fire trucks equipped with an Innovative Controls instrument panel. A software error may cause the odometer to freeze and not display accurate mileage.

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Steering Wheel May Turn Unintentionally (339 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2020-2023 LFS transit buses. The electric power steering system may be missing a check valve, allowing hydraulic pressure to turn the steering wheel without the driver's input.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: Air Bags May Fail to Deploy (2,119 affected)
summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Revel Sport, 2024-2025 Vita, 2025 Porto, Adventure Wagon, 2024-2026 View, Revel, Navion, and Ekko motorhomes. Supplemental Restraint System (SRS) wires can be caught in the seat mechanism when the driver or passenger seats are adjusted.

title: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini): Door Springs May Fail Unexpectedly (27 affected)
summary: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Revuelto vehicles. The gas springs that allow the doors to open and stay open, may fail due to improperly assembled support pins in the springs.

title: Ferrari North America, Inc.: Loss of Braking Ability (541 affected)
summary: Ferrari North America, Inc. (Ferrari) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Purosangue vehicles. The fuse box’s power supply and the passenger-side footrest may contact each other, possibly resulting in a short circuit that activates the brake warning light and decreases the vehicle's braking ability.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Loss of Drive Power (71,286 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2022-2025 i4, 2022-2024 IX, 2023-2024 I7, and 2024 I5 vehicles. The electric drive motor software may shut down the high-voltage system, causing a loss of drive power.

title: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc.: Alternator Controller Programming May Cause Engine Stall (418 affected)
summary: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc. (Tiffin) is recalling certain 2024 Convoy, 2023-2026 GH1, 2025 GT1, and 2026 GH2 motorhomes equipped with 2.0 liter engine. The secondary alternator controller programming was not properly updated.

title: General Motors, LLC: High Voltage Battery Not Secured Properly (53 affected)
summary: General Motors (GM) is recalling certain 2026 Cadillac VISTIQ vehicles and 2025 Cadillac LYRIQ vehicles. The bolts attaching the high voltage battery to the interior floor may be missing or loose.

title: Hyundai Motor America: High Voltage Battery May Catch Fire (10 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2025 IONIQ 5 vehicles. The high voltage battery system may contain an improperly tightened bus bar, which can cause a short-circuit.

title: Ford Motor Company: Seat Belt Warning System Malfunction/FMVSS 208 (56,473 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 F-150 hybrid vehicles equipped with a 3.5L hybrid electric powertrain. When the driver or passenger's seat belt is not buckled and the vehicle is started, the audible warning chime may not activate as intended. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: Ford Motor Company: Loss of Power Brake Assist (312,120 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Lincoln Navigator, F-150, Expedition, Bronco, and Ranger vehicles. The Electronic Brake Booster (EBB) module may malfunction while driving or when the driver is utilizing an Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) feature, resulting in a loss of power brake assist.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Loss of Drive Power (660 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2022-2023  EQB 350 4MATIC, and EQB 300 4MATIC vehicles. The bus bar in the high voltage battery may be secured with incorrect screws, which can cause the system to have a sudden loss of drive power without warning.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Fuel Line Extension May Detach and Cause Fire (534 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Sunseeker, Solera, Forester, Freelander, Leprechaun, and East to West Entrada motorhomes. The fuel line extension connectors  may have inconsistent crimps, allowing the fuel line to detach.

title: Ford Motor Company: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display (59 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain Bronco Upfit kits sold as accessory parts with part numbers M-BRONCO-WAD, -WBD, -W3, -W4, -W9, -W10, -W11, and W12. The rearview camera on the spare tire carrier may not be compatible with certain 2024-2025 Ford Bronco vehicles.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Emergency Call (eCall) System Failure (33 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2025 F 900 GS, F 800 GS, R 1300 GS Adventure, R 1300 GS, S 1000 RR, S 1000 R, and K 1600 GT vehicles equipped with the optional emergency call system. The emergency call system (eCall) may have been deactivated due to a software programming error.

title: Ford Motor Company: Rear Windows May Fail to Reverse Direction/FMVSS 118 (23,111 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025 Lincoln Aviator vehicles. When closing the windows with the global closing feature, the side rear windows may exert excessive force when encountering an object, before they automatically reverse. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 118, "Power-Operated Window Systems."

title: Kia America, Inc.: Door Belt Molding Trim Can Detach While Driving (201,149 affected)
summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Telluride vehicles. The door belt molding trim can delaminate and detach from the vehicle.

title: Kia America, Inc.: Rear Window Trim Pieces May Detach (100,063 affected)
summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2023-2025 K5 vehicles. The left and right rear window trim pieces may loosen and detach.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: Front Seat Air Bag May Deploy Improperly (3 affected)
summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Macan 4 Electric vehicles. The front seat air bags may be improperly secured to the backrest frame, which can prevent the air bags from deploying properly.

title: Tesla, Inc.: A Loose Ground Wire May Prevent Horn From Sounding (6 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2026 Model Y vehicles. The ring terminal of the horn ground wire may be improperly secured, allowing the circuit to open and preventing the horn from sounding.

title: Grech Motors Inc.: Awning May Extend Unintentionally (1,276 affected)
summary: Grech Motors Inc. (Grech) is recalling certain 2022-2023, 2025 Terreno, 2021-2025 Turismo, and 2020-2025 Strada motorhomes. The retractable awning may extend unintentionally during transit.

title: Terran Industries LLC: Incorrect Suspension System Components Installed in Axle Assemblies (500 affected)
summary: Terran Industries LLC (Terran Industries) is recalling certain 7000lb axle assemblies, part number ST70B. Incorrect suspension system components may have been installed in the axle assemblies.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: Reduced Brake Function/FMVSS 121 (36 affected)
summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2026 Mack GR trucks. The brake drum and steer axle combination are incompatible, which may cause a loss of brake function. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 121, "Air Brake Systems."

title: Brinkley RV: Wires May Become Damaged and Short Circuit (35 affected)
summary: Brinkley RV (Brinkley) is recalling certain 2025 Model Z trailers. The electrical wiring may not be secured properly, which can result in damaged wiring and a short circuit.

title: Storyteller Overland: Improperly Tightened 30-Amp Shore Power Inlet May Cause Fire (106 affected)
summary: Storyteller Overland, LLC (Storyteller) is recalling certain 2023 Mode LT recreational vehicles. The exterior shore power inlet may have been improperly tightened.

title: Premier Trailer Solutions LLC: Improperly Installed Hub Oil Seal May Leak Oil (3 affected)
summary: Premier Trailer Solutions LLC (Premier Trailer) is recalling certain 2024 Reel and Pole trailers. The oil seals may have been improperly installed, allowing oil to leak onto the brake system.
